# Bronian – Freelance Graphic Designer Portfolio

> Bronian (Mohit) is a Freelance Graphic Designer & Visual Thinker based in India, specializing in branding, print, illustration, and video editing.

## About

Mohit, known as Bronian, is a freelance graphic designer who believes design should provoke, not just please. He specializes in brand identities, digital experiences, and visual systems that refuse to be ignored. He is available for freelance graphic design work globally.

## Services

### Brand Identity – Starting at ₹5,000
Logo design, color systems, typography selection, brand guidelines, and full visual identity packages that tell your story.

### Video Editing – Starting at ₹8,000
Professional video editing including cuts, transitions, color grading, sound design, and motion graphics. Polished and ready for publishing.

### Print & Packaging – Starting at ₹5,000
Posters, business cards, brochures, product packaging, and editorial layouts for physical media.

### Illustration – Starting at ₹5,000
Custom digital illustrations, icon sets, and visual assets for campaigns, products, and editorial use.

## Process

1. **Discovery** – We talk about your brand, goals, audience, and vision. I ask the hard questions upfront.
2. **Concept** – I explore multiple directions and present 2-3 strong concepts with mood boards and rationale.
3. **Refine** – We iterate on the chosen direction. Two rounds of revisions are included in every project.
4. **Deliver** – You receive production-ready files in all formats you need, plus a style guide for consistency.

## Skills

Branding, Logo Design, Video Editing, Typography, Illustration, Print Design, Packaging, Motion Graphics
